methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for AI image-generation tools (Midjourney, OpenAI/ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, Leonardo.ai, Ideogram, Recraft, Krea) was collected from each vendor's public pricing page on the accessedAt date and normalized to USD; where a vendor's live pricing page blocked automated fetching, the published figures were taken from independent pricing references and cross-checked, with a corroborating source attached. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month list price for flat tiers and the per-seat/per-user list price for per_seat tiers (noted in plan notes), with annualDiscountPct capturing the published annual saving. These are not telephony products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan, HIPAA/BAA/bilingual are null, and quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry a null price rather than an estimate.

vendors.name: Midjourney
vendors.provenance: Prices read from midjourney.com/pricing (and the Midjourney subscription-plans documentation) on 2026-06-13; the live page blocked automated fetch, figures corroborated against an independent pricing reference.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $10/mo month-to-month; $8/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~3.3 fast GPU hours (about 200 minutes) per month, commercial usage rights (companies under $1M annual revenue), no Relax mode, no Stealth mode.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $30/mo month-to-month; $24/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~15 fast GPU hours per month plus unlimited Relax mode generation, commercial usage rights (companies under $1M annual revenue).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $60/mo month-to-month; $48/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~30 fast GPU hours per month, unlimited Relax mode, Stealth Mode (private generation), full commercial rights, 12 concurrent fast jobs.

plans.name: Mega
plans.notes: $120/mo month-to-month; $96/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~60 fast GPU hours per month, unlimited Relax mode, Stealth Mode, full commercial rights.

vendors.name: OpenAI ChatGPT
vendors.provenance: Consumer plan prices read from openai.com/chatgpt/pricing on 2026-06-13; live page blocked automated fetch, figures corroborated against an independent pricing reference. Image generation is delivered through ChatGPT Images 2.0 (the GPT Image / former DALL-E pipeline) on every tier.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0. ChatGPT Images 2.0 Instant Mode image generation included, limited message/usage windows; US users see ads.

plans.name: Go
plans.notes: $8/mo. Higher message limits than Free (~10x), image creation and file uploads included; US users see ads.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $20/mo. ChatGPT Images 2.0 with Thinking Mode (reasoning, web search, consistency across up to 8 images), generous model access, no ads.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $200/mo. ~20x Plus usage limits, highest image-generation and Sora video quotas, 1M-token context; a $100/mo Pro tier with 5x Plus limits also exists. All paid tiers include ChatGPT Images 2.0 image generation.

vendors.name: Adobe Firefly
vendors.provenance: Prices read from adobe.com/products/firefly/plans.html on 2026-06-13; live page timed out on automated fetch, figures corroborated against an independent pricing reference verified 2026-06-09.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0. Limited generative credits per month, watermarked outputs.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $9.99/mo. 2,000 generative credits per month, unlimited standard image generation, up to 20 five-second video clips. Credits do not roll over.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $19.99/mo. 4,000 generative credits per month, access to multiple AI models, up to 40 five-second video clips, Adobe Photoshop included.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $199.99/mo. 50,000 generative credits per month, unlimited five-second video generation, priority processing, full Photoshop access.

vendors.name: Leonardo.ai
vendors.provenance: Prices read from leonardo.ai/pricing on 2026-06-13; live page blocked automated fetch, figures corroborated against an independent pricing reference. Tier names shown as Apprentice/Artisan/Maestro (rebranded Essential/Premium/Ultimate).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0. 150 fast tokens per day (150 token bank), for casual creators exploring AI art.

plans.name: Apprentice
plans.notes: $12/mo month-to-month; $9.60/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). 8,500 fast tokens/month plus 25,500 token-bank rollover.

plans.name: Artisan
plans.notes: $30/mo month-to-month; $24/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). 25,000 fast tokens/month plus 75,000 token-bank rollover, for semi-professionals needing more output.

plans.name: Maestro
plans.notes: $60/mo month-to-month; $48/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). 60,000 fast tokens/month plus 180,000 token-bank rollover, API access, for professional creators and small businesses.

vendors.name: Ideogram
vendors.provenance: Prices read from ideogram.ai/pricing on 2026-06-13; live page is a JS app that blocked automated extraction, figures corroborated against an independent pricing reference. Month-to-month list prices shown; annual billing discounts noted per plan.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0. 10 slow credits per week, public images only, unlimited slow-queue access.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: ~$20/mo month-to-month; ~$15/mo equivalent at annual billing (25% off). 1,000 priority credits/month, private images, priority queue, 8 concurrent generations.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: ~$60/mo month-to-month; ~$42/mo equivalent at annual billing (30% off). 3,500 priority credits/month, batch generation, 32 concurrent generations, priority queue.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: ~$30/user/mo month-to-month; ~$20/user/mo at annual billing. 1,500 priority credits per user/month, central billing, shared administration, collaboration tools.

vendors.name: Recraft
vendors.provenance: Prices read from recraft.ai/docs/plans-and-billing/paid-plans on 2026-06-13 (primary source fetched directly).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0. ~50 daily credits; generated images are public and without commercial licensing rights.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $12/mo month-to-month; $10/mo equivalent at annual billing ($120/yr). 1,000 credits/month, private image generation and commercial usage rights while subscribed.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Entry Pro tier: $20/mo month-to-month ($16/mo annual) for 2,000 credits. Pro scales by credit bucket: 4,000 credits $40/mo ($32 annual), 8,000 credits $80/mo ($64 annual), 16,000 credits $160/mo ($128 annual). Private generation, commercial usage rights.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Entry Teams tier: $22/seat/mo month-to-month ($18/seat/mo annual) for 2,000 credits; scales to 4,000 ($44/$35), 8,000 ($88/$70) and 16,000 ($176/$141) credits. Adds shared custom styles, centralized account management, premium 24/7 support, Single Sign-On (SSO).

vendors.name: Krea
vendors.provenance: Prices read from krea.ai/pricing on 2026-06-13 (primary source fetched directly). monthlyUsd records the month-to-month list price; the per-plan notes give the yearly total and published annual saving.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0. 100 compute units per day, full access to real-time models, limited access to image/video/3D models, basic 2K upscaling, limited LoRA training.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $9/mo at yearly billing ($63/yr, ~40% savings). 5,000 compute units/month, Krea 2 access, commercial license, full image/3D/lipsync models, LoRA training up to 50 images, 4K upscaling, selected video models. Credits do not roll over.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $35/mo at yearly billing ($252/yr, ~40% savings). 20,000 compute units/month, full access to all video models, Nodes workflow automation, AI Nodes Agent, 8K upscaling.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $70/mo at yearly billing ($756/yr, ~40% savings). 60,000 compute units/month, unlimited LoRA fine-tunings, unlimited concurrency, unlimited relaxed generations, 22K upscaling.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $200/mo at yearly billing ($1,920/yr, ~20% savings). 80,000 compute units/month, up to 50 included seats, custom user roles/permissions, LoRA training up to 20,000 images, fine-grained model access controls.
